name: v0.3.34 — white canvas + route fade-slide + WebView linking scaffold
releaseNotes:
• Mobile + web canvases both pure white now (was slate-50/lime gradient). Cards, tiles, and gradients keep their own colors; the page background stays neutral so brand chrome reads cleanly.
• Route transitions on mobile: every navigation now runs a 220ms cross-fade + 1.5% slide-up. Was missing entirely on context.go() replace-style nav (which is most of the bottom-nav tab + sidebar). Cupertino edge-swipe still works as before on push.
• Phase-1 scaffolding for retailer credential linking: WebView screen at /connections/link/<id>, JS-extraction framework with an Amazon orders-page DOM scraper as the proof-of-concept. Marked clearly as PoC — full backend ingest + multi-retailer support is Phase 2.
• /connections/link/<retailer> only surfaces a 'Link account (PoC)' button when an extractor exists for that retailer (currently Amazon only). Other retailers continue with the email-forwarding setup steps.
